title: Deep Learning for Operator Maps in Optimal Liquidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We analyze the solution map of a optimal execution problem in which price dynamics are subject to a general transient impact kernel. Given the structure of the optimal trading strategy derived by Abi Jaber and Neuman in \cite{https://doi.org/10.1111/mafi.12465}, we show that the strategy is locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to the underlying model parameters governing temporary and transient price impact as well as the fundamental price process. Continuity of this map justifies the application of neural-net based approximations which take model parameters as inputs. We propose a method generating samples of the transient price impact kernel for the purposes of creating training data, and a method of projecting the kernel to a finite dimensional representation appropriate for input to a neural net, and a dimensional reduction based on the relationship between inventory and trade signal. translated_title: 最优清算中的算子映射深度学习
translated_abstract: 我们分析了最优执行问题的解映射，其中价格动态受到一般瞬态冲击核的影响。基于Abi Jaber和Neuman推导出的最优交易策略的结构，我们证明了该策略关于控制临时价格冲击和瞬态价格冲击以及基础价格过程的底层模型参数是局部Lipschitz连续的。这一映射的连续性为以模型参数作为输入的基于神经网络的近似方法提供了理论依据。我们提出了一种生成瞬态价格冲击核样本以创建训练数据的方法，一种将该核投影为适合神经网络输入的有限维表示的方法，以及一种基于库存与交易信号之间关系的降维方法。我们展示了训练方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文证明了最优执行策略对价格冲击模型参数具有局部Lipschitz连续性，为利用神经网络近似最优清算策略提供了理论依据，并提出了生成瞬态冲击核训练样本及降维的方法。
